title: Modular Smithing 2
description: Modular Smithing 2's crafting on a new world and on a save made with its last release: armor weighs and costs what MS2 says, the designer's tier matches the game's, ammo flies at native speed, crafted items survive a save and reload, old items keep their stats after an update, damage types and their one-time notice work, and no helper piece from another mod becomes a crafted look.
